snippet.title: Path of Exile 2: Fate of the Vaal League Teaser
snippet.description: Watch the live reveal of the Fate of the Vaal League on December 4th (PST) at twitch.tv/pathofexile. Play the new content update for free from December 12–15 (PST)!
